## Price per MW needed for a 12% equity return

The contract price at which equity NPV at 12% is zero. This is what cheaper financing buys: the same build works at a lower price.

| Hyperscaler, 5-year | $13.7M | $11.7M | $-2.0M | $12.0M |
| Core, 1–3 year | $15.8M | $13.5M | $-2.3M | $22.5M |
| Short-term and auction | $23.2M | $16.4M | $-6.8M | $40.0M |

## Sensitivity: the hyperscaler tier

One input changed at a time. The 5-year tier is the one that matters: it is most of the build and the only tier priced close to its cost.

| Change | Needed price, current | Needed price, proposed | Equity per MW, proposed | Equity IRR at $12M, proposed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Base inputs | $13.7M | $11.7M | $7.8M | 15.8% |
| Power and operations $3.0M per MW (vs $1.87M) | $14.8M | $12.8M | $11.2M | 2.8% |
| Project margin 50%, the AI cloud segment's (opex $6.0M per MW) | $17.5M | $15.6M | $20.0M | -17.2% |
| GPU residual 0% (vs 15%) | $14.5M | $12.5M | $7.8M | 2.2% |
| GPU residual 30% | $12.9M | $11.0M | $7.8M | 24.6% |
| Shell rent yield 9.5% (vs 8%) | $13.7M | $12.0M | $8.8M | 11.5% |
| GPU loan at SOFR + 5.50% instead of + 2.50% | $13.7M | $12.1M | $9.4M | 10.6% |
| Prepayment 10% of contract value (vs 20%) | $14.2M | $12.1M | $10.3M | 11.3% |
| Prepayment 44% of contract value (the workbook's 45% of capex) | $12.6M | $11.0M | $3.0M | 42.2% |

**Read this first:** the model sizes debt on *project* cash flow (contract revenue less power and site operations), as a lender does. The AI cloud segment's 50% EBITDA margin also carries the platform, R&D, sales and leased-site rent, which stay at the parent. If 50% were the project margin, no financing structure makes a $12M contract work, which is the funding model review's finding.

## The 2027–2030 build: 4.33 GW

GW added per year from the reconciled funding model (1.08, 1.08, 1.08, 1.08). Shares are counted at **$221.33** (2026-10-09 close); dilution is against 308.7M year-end 2026 shares. Equity here is before operating cash flow, which in the funding model pays for part of the build in later years.

**Debt follows contracts.** Tranche A can only be drawn against signed investment-grade contracts. Nebius cited ~$40B of IG contracted revenue available to finance in July 2026; at $60.0M of contract value per MW that covers ~0.67 GW. The base mix needs $156.0B.

**Prepayments are set per contract, not per dollar of capex.** Deferred revenue was $6.0B against $37.5B of RPO at June 30 (16% of contract value); IREN's Microsoft prepayment was ~20%. The workbook's 45% of capex equals ~44% of a 5-year hyperscaler contract, which no customer has paid so far (see the sensitivity).

## Secured debt schedule, base mix, proposed structure ($B)

A vintage is built and drawn in its build year, earns from the next year, and amortizes over its contract. Cash available for debt service covers every vintage in operation, after shell rent. A site's rent is counted while its first GPUs run; after year 5 the 20-year lease is carried by the GPU refresh, which needs its own contract and tranche and is not modeled.

## Term sheet

| | A. Contract-backed GPU loan | B. Core-contract DDTL | C. Shell sale-leaseback | D. Corporate converts / equity |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Borrower | One ring-fenced subsidiary per contract or site pool (template: Nebius Compute II, LLC / Oy) | Ring-fenced subsidiary per contract pool | Infrastructure partner's JV / property company | Nebius Group N.V. |
| Collateral | GPUs, assignment of the customer contract, project accounts | GPUs, contracts, accounts | The land, building and power equipment | Unsecured |
| Tenor | Equal to the contract (5 years); fully amortizing | Equal to the contract (1–3 years); fully amortizing | 15–20 year lease, renewal options | 2030–2034 (existing notes) |
| Sizing | Lower of 1.25x DSCR on contract cash flow and 95% of GPU cost less prepayment | Lower of 1.35x DSCR and the same 95% cap | 100% of shell cost | Residual |
| Pricing | SOFR + 2.50% (Nebius/MUFG, July 2026) | SOFR + 5.50% at 97, 10.44% yield (CoreWeave DDTL 5.5, Aug 2026) | ~8% rent yield (assumption; Hyperion ~6.6%, QTS 7.23%) | 0.50% (2030) / 4.50% (2034) coupons, 40–45% conversion premium (Aug 2026) |
| Covenants | Min DSCR, 6-month debt service reserve, distribution lock-up below 1.15x, parent liquidity | Same, plus a cash sweep if the contract isn't renewed 6 months before maturity | Rent ranks ahead of GPU debt at the site; Nebius parent guarantee | None beyond indenture |
| Precedents | Nebius $775M (Jul 2026); CoreWeave DDTL 4.0, SOFR + 2.25%, A3; IREN $3.6B at ~5.9% | CoreWeave DDTL 5.0 (SOFR + 4.50%) and 5.5 (SOFR + 5.50%) | Meta/Blue Owl Hyperion (80/20, A+); QTS $3.9B at 7.23% | Nebius converts, Mar and Aug 2026 |

**Cash waterfall in each borrower:** customer receipts → power and site operations → shell rent → senior interest and principal → reserve top-up → distributions to Nebius only above 1.15x DSCR.
